t: This is Palace Court, a street in Bayswater running from Bayswater Road in the south up to Moscow Road in the north. It was developed in the 1880s, later than the streets around it, and it's considered a microcosm of late Victorian architecture, especially the Arts and Crafts style. Lord Walter Gordon-Lennox died here in 1922. He was a Conservative politician who served as Treasurer of the Household from 1891 to 1892 under Lord Salisbury.
